name: Jane Parkinson
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: As a Registered Play Therapist (APTA), I provide play therapy support for children aged 3 - 10 with a wide range of social, emotional & behavioural challenges. I am also a Family Violence Counsellor & a Level 2 trained EMDR practitioner with a passion for supporting adoptive, foster & kinship care families. I provide counselling to adults impacted by complex trauma, as well as parent/caregiver victim-survivors of FV (especially where consent cannot be obtained for a child victim-survivor to access therapy). I have extensive experience in the Family Violence sector & am thrilled to have added EMDR with adults & children to my list of therapeutic services.

name: Josie van der Wal
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: We are dedicated to providing compassionate, person-centered Counselling & Play Therapy supporting children, adolescents, and their significant people, navigating their emotions, behaviours, and challenges. We are an inclusive, welcoming place with a strengths-based and rights-based approach.

name: Trish Rossi
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
practice: Trish Rossi Psychotherapy and Relationship Counselling
description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery.

name: Eva Deligiannis
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I use a Gestalt Psychotherapy approach that builds awareness and understanding of barriers to the changes that we want for yourselves. In my psychotherapy practice I create a supportive space to address mental health issues that are preventing individuals to live a fulfilling and satisfying life. I support my clients to increase self-awareness, gain new skills that enables them both professionally and personally to choice-fully, moving forward in their lives.

name: Amelia Ducker
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I am a Jungian- Oriented Psychotherapist working with Adults and Adolescents in Richmond and Surrey Hills, Melbourne. I support concerns such as anxiety, life transitions, identity, and relationships. My approach is collaborative, relational, and process-oriented, allowing space for each person’s experience to unfold in its own time.

name: Fatma Akbas
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I am working mobile and online in northern suburbs of Melbourne with women's and children.

name: Kanling Juric
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Kanling Juric is a trauma-informed and person-centred Art Therapist. She is the founder of Cerulean Space, a Melbourne art therapy private practice offering community-based, corporate and private art therapy services. Kanling is an ANZACATA registered Art Therapist with a Master of Art Therapy; and a Clay Field Therapist (Institute for Sensorimotor Art Therapy). - Online and in-person (Art therapy studio based in Avondale Heights.

name: Anne Lynn Teoh
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Relational Systems Therapy offers couples counselling, relationship and individual psychotherapy in-person in Brunswick plus surrounding suburbs & online across Australia. We support adults and couples experiencing recurring conflict, emotional distance, relationship stress in power differentials, infidelity, separation, break-up recovery, low self-worth and boundary difficulties; as well as perinatal couples and the relational strain of early parenthood transition. Our work is gender-sensitive, trauma-informed and systems-aware.
specialties: Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy
